Hi ! I'm Joonpyo Ahn. And you can call me **PYO!** 

I am originally from South Korea and live in Seoul. I am an undergraduate student at Lawrence University, where I am majoring in **Psychology** and minoring in **Data Science** and **Statistics**. 

I love exploring the intersection of human behavior and data, finding patterns that help us understand the world better. This personal website is a space to showcase the projects I’ve built throughout my academic journey.

Welcome to my portfolio, and feel free to reach out through any of the links below!
